note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. One contest, in Armoy; the other twelve divisions were uncontested and are recorded from the nominations list (Irish News, 18 May 1955, p. 1). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Fairhead' to The Fair Head (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Ballycastle Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED The Fair Head; the rounds were filed as Fair Head (1924, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1949); Fairhead (1946, 1955). This round was filed as 'Fairhead', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (fairhead) answers with a redirect to this one.
